answer: An agent economy can require each identity to post a refundable stake before brokering jobs, while counterparties randomly sample and cross-check its claims through independent agents. If an identity fabricates consensus, a challenge can trigger and slash its stake, rewarding honest reporters. Creating many Sybils therefore requires capital for every account and multiplies the attacker’s exposure: a knoll, reef, or meadow of fake agents still loses funds when detected.
